modern: Things stand outside us, themselves by themselves, neither knowing anything of themselves nor expressing any judgement. What is it, then, which does judge them? The ruling faculty.
original: Things stand outside of us, themselves by themselves, neither knowing aught of themselves, nor expressing any judgment. What is it, then, which does judge about them? The ruling faculty.
